**Finding: IP — compliant (no redline).**

This APCN 2 consortium construction-and-maintenance agreement has no IP, work-product or Customer Data provisions at all; targeted searches for "intellectual property", "work product", "deliverable", "copyright", "patent" and "licence/license" return no hits. The ownership language in the document is asset ownership and it runs in our favour — Terminal Parties own the Segments they provide, Wet Segment ownership tracks our Schedule B investment share, and we take Allocated Capacity on an ownership basis in return for our investment; an IRU expressly conveys no ownership. Our data is protected, not licensed away: Paragraph 31 obliges every Party to hold APCN 2 data and information confidential, subject only to regulatory/court and operational-necessity exceptions.

No walk-away trigger exists (no assignment of our IP or data to a counterparty, no joint IP ownership). The undivided common ownership of the Wet Segment is joint ownership of a physical asset and the core consortium bargain, paired with our capacity and IRU resale rights, so we have flagged it only as a note rather than as a deviation.
